title: 眉毛少还能做吗？先看五官、骨相与原生眉毛
title_en: Can very sparse brows be designed? Facial features, bone structure and existing brow hairs
intro: 从只有淡淡一层绒毛到“几乎无眉”，不同基础能不能做野生眉、做出来靠不靠得住自然，关键在于骨相依托和线条虚实控制。
intro_en: From faint fuzz to nearly absent brows, suitability depends on underlying bone structure and how edge softness and spacing are handled.

sections.title: 近乎无眉的基础，怎么不画成“两条孤零零的线条”
sections.title_en: Nearly bare brows: avoiding two isolated drawn lines
sections.description: 天生眉毛极少或长期剃眉导致毛量寥寥无几的人，最担心做完野生眉因为没有真毛遮掩，线条显得像印在皮肤上的笔画。遇到这种基础，面诊设计时重心会放到眉弓骨隆起位置、眼窝凹陷边界和眉眼距上：必须靠骨相定位眉形的高低落差，在眉骨转折处做柔和的线条错落与虚实留白，避免四条边界都画得死平对称。
sections.description_en: When very few natural hairs exist to blend with strokes, the risk is a flat, stamped appearance. Design anchors the shape directly to the brow ridge, orbital rim and eye-to-brow spacing, staggering stroke edges and leaving skin gaps instead of tracing rigid upper and lower borders.

sections.title: 色浅毛细 vs 局部无眉，发色和肤色的配色逻辑
sections.title_en: Faint light hair vs patchy areas: matching colour to hair and skin
sections.description: 不少人其实有眉毛，只是颜色非常浅、毛丝细软，远看几乎隐形。这种情况绝对不能套用深黑或冷灰重色，否则新加线条会和原本的浅淡毛发“两张皮”。调色时会结合本人发色、瞳色和皮肤底色来配比柔和自然的棕灰调，让线条贴近原本绒毛的深浅节奏。
sections.description_en: Fine, pale hairs that look invisible from a distance clash immediately if paired with dark charcoal pigment. Pigment blends are matched to natural hair, iris and skin undertones so strokes sit softly beside fine existing hair.

sections.title: 如果完全没毛、想要带一点底妆雾感怎么办
sections.title_en: When zero-hair bases prefer a hint of powder softness
sections.description: 需要客观看待的是，野生眉本质是通过线条与色素模拟毛流的视觉表达，不可能凭空长出真实立体的眉毛。如果几乎无眉、且平时几乎天天带全妆，或者偏爱稍微饱满一点的眉妆效果，面诊时除了双仪器初绒野生眉，也可以对比丝雾眉或绒雾眉在皮肤上的呈现差异，再选最贴合自己平时照镜子习惯的方案。
sections.description_en: Pigmentation creates visual hair-stroke illusion rather than growing real three-dimensional hair. For bare bases that wear full makeup daily, comparing dual-instrument hair strokes with silk-shaded or velvet-shaded brows during consultation helps pick what looks best in your everyday mirror.

sections.title: 免费到店试画30–45分钟：适合再做，不硬推
sections.title_en: Free 30–45 minute trial consultation: honest assessment first
sections.description: 眉毛极少越不能盲目直接约操作。来描眉画目可先约免费到店设计，约30–45分钟，乐乐老师会结合你的面部骨骼与想要的气质，先在脸上把毛流定位和轮廓画出来给你看；适合才接，有局限或需调整预期会当面说清，不做不收费，所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Very sparse brows benefit most from seeing the drawn design before committing. Book a free 30–45 minute consultation with Lele to inspect the proposed contour and stroke direction directly on your face, with honest discussion of limits and free touch-ups within one year if you proceed.
